purpose: Upgrade the patched opencode 1.x binary to a newer upstream tag while re-applying every ordered local fix, then verify all fixes survived bundling before staging it for OpenChamber.
upstreamConstraint: v1.x only. NEVER target v2+: packages/opencode/ does not exist there and OpenChamber 1.24.2 requires OpenCode 1.x.

fixes.title: Anchor the compaction summary to the marker message
markers: marker already carries a completed summary
fixes.why: prompt.ts passed parentID: lastUser.id for the compaction summary, so a prompt landing in the marker-to-summary window orphaned the summary (infinite compaction) and discarded the marker's model (a plugin-supplied pin). Anchoring to the marker repairs both.

fixes.title: Stop unfinished compaction summaries instead of retrying
markers: Compaction stream ended without a terminal finish
fixes.why: A summary stream that ended without finish was treated as continue, so the same marker was selected again indefinitely. Persisting an error finish and returning stop makes the failed marker terminal and prevents the retry storm.

build.note: OPENCODE_VERSION must be set or the binary reports a dev version and free-tier models reject it with 426 'OpenCode 1.18.0 or newer is required'.

stage.note: Stable filename on purpose: the User environment variable OPENCODE_BINARY points here forever, so an upgrade never requires re-pinning.
stage.pinMechanism: OPENCODE_BINARY, User scope. OpenChamber resolves its binary at startup as `process.env.OPENCODE_BINARY || searchPathFor('opencode')` - the env var is read FIRST and is the only durable pin.
stage.settingsKeyNote: COSMETIC ONLY. OpenChamber drops this key on every settings rewrite (observed 2026-09-25 at 18:57:50 and 19:10:49) and never reads it at startup. Do not rely on it.

restartNote: OpenChamber must be restarted to load a newly staged binary - the env var is read at startup. Verify with managed-opencode/<pid>.json: it must record the staged path, not ...\resources\opencode-cli\opencode.exe.
